Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 11: the slip of [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“[Pilot] 2. Deploys -2 to a forest. Luke's weapon destiny draws are +1. At same site, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon. During opponent's draw phase, if alone on Endor, may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 5.”), word for word the text of [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V) (Virtual Block 3)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
